description: This vulnerability pattern occurs in distributed consensus systems that separate consensus logic from state execution (e.g., Ethereum's consensus-execution split, Cosmos SDK app-chain architecture, or any system with pluggable consensus). The core issue is the failure to enforce monotonicity of finality commitments across the interface boundary between consensus and execution layers.
trigger_condition: A Byzantine or compromised consensus client sends state update messages with finality markers that point to earlier blockchain heights than previously confirmed finalized blocks, and the execution/application layer accepts these without validation.
